seoTitle: Gérard & Fils - Furniture storage Brussels - storage units to rent
seoDesc: Our removal company offers storage units of different sizes to rent in its furniture storage facility in Brussels.
h1: Rent a storage unit in our furniture storage facility in Brussels

body.p: Looking for reliable, secure furniture storage in Brussels? Gérard & Fils provides storage space suited to every need: furniture, equipment, archives or personal belongings. Whether for a move in Schaerbeek, building work or a temporary need for space, our furniture storage service is secure and flexible. Rent a storage space in our monitored premises, accessible on request!

Our self-storage plans are fully flexible, whether you need space for a few weeks or several months. You choose the duration that best suits your situation, with clear, competitive rates for private individuals and professionals alike.

Transport, packing and storage of your belongings in your unit are carried out by our team to guarantee impeccable storage. Your belongings are protected from damp and theft. You can collect your things on site in complete safety, accompanied by one of our removers, or ask us to deliver them back to your home.

We have several centres in Brussels, including Laeken, Schaerbeek and Jette, to give you convenient and quick access to your belongings. Whether for a move, building work or simply a temporary lack of space, our furniture storage is the ideal solution for protecting and managing your furniture and personal items.

sections.h: What can you store in our furniture storage?

body.p: Our storage space in Brussels lets you keep the following safely, in a unit of the right size and for as long as you choose:

ul: Your bulky, large pieces of furniture: piano, sofa, sideboard, wardrobes…
Your household appliances: washing machine, fridge, dishwasher…
Your clothes, household linen and other textiles (curtains, hangings…)
Your sports equipment: bicycle, skis, surfboard…
Your multimedia equipment: television, computer, screens…
Your works of art and antiques

body.p: Ventilated, climate-controlled and secure, our storage units are designed to keep your belongings in optimal conditions so that you can retrieve them in impeccable condition whenever you wish. Your belongings are packed and arranged by us to make the best use of the space available in the storage facility.

If you are planning a move in north-west Brussels, our furniture storage is an ideal complement to our transport services. For example, if you are preparing a move in the Jette area, you can entrust your belongings to our secure centre while you empty your old home or organise the move into your new one. Our self-storage units are flexible and suitable for any type of contents, from bulky furniture to sensitive archives, with competitive and flexible rates according to your needs. Book your space today and enjoy safe, practical storage perfectly suited to your situation.

sections.h: Why rent furniture storage in Brussels?

body.p: Several situations may call for furniture storage, for a fixed or open-ended period. Over the years we accumulate plenty of furniture and other items that clutter our living spaces: renting a storage unit in Brussels solves your lack of space. Other situations also justify renting furniture storage:

ul: An inheritance: you have inherited a relative's belongings and do not yet know where to keep them, or when you will sort through them?
A move: you cannot move into your new home straight away after leaving the old one?
Building work at your home or offices: you are looking for storage space to clear the area until the work is finished?
A stay abroad: you are leaving Belgium for a long period and want to find your furniture intact on your return?

body.p: Gérard & Fils always has the solution you need and offers safe storage plans, wherever you live in Brussels. Whether you want to store your furniture, equipment or other belongings, our services suit private individuals and professionals alike. We guarantee optimal security for all your items, whatever they are. Contact us today to discover our storage options and find the ideal solution for your needs.

sections.h: Tailor-made service for individuals and professionals

body.p: Whether you are a private individual or a business in Brussels, we offer storage options suited to your needs.
Not sure where to keep your furniture during a move within the capital or renovation work? Our furniture storage is the ideal solution for protecting it temporarily, whatever its size or volume.

Do you run a company or a shop and need to manage surplus stock, archive documents or store equipment you do not use all the time? Are you relocating your offices? Take advantage of our dedicated business services, with secure and flexible storage solutions that adapt to your requirements.

Booking your furniture storage space in Brussels is simple and quick. Just call us or fill in our online form. As soon as we receive your request, we will send you a clear offer based on the duration you want and the volume to be stored. Our team is here to guide you towards the most practical and economical solution for your situation.
